Pipeline Architecture

A 4-stage automated pipeline replacing a decade of manual, session-by-session trademark tracking.

Stage 1

PDF Extraction

pdfplumber extracts tables from IP Office PDFs. Two parser versions handle different registry formats.

Stage 2

Normalisation

Regex cleans 9 entity name variants and 33 raw status strings into 20 canonical values.

Stage 3

Excel Export

Multi-sheet formatted workbook — one sheet per entity plus Master and Unique Mark Names sheets.

Stage 4

Visualisation

12 charts across 4 types — status distribution, portfolio health, donut grid, entity dashboards.

Methodology & Notes

Data Source

Pakistani Intellectual Property Office (IPO) PDF exports. 556 raw records extracted. 36 false matches dropped (individuals sharing a name fragment with client entities — documented and justified). 520 clean records retained across 9 entities.

Status Normalisation

33 raw status variants reduced to 20 canonical values via startswith() pattern matching with explicit ordering to prevent partial-match shadowing.

Clean / Grey / Red Classification

Clean — Trademark Registered, Certificate Printed, Ready To Be Registered, Under Examination, Acceptance Publication, Reception.
Grey — Grace Period, Hearing, Reminder Due, Order Section, Awaiting Opposition.
Red — Opposition Decisions, Opposition Period Finished, Abandoned, To Be Abandoned, Withdrawn, Migrated, Refused, Removed, TM Reg. - Rectification received.

Anonymisation

Entity names use initial abbreviations (e.g. I. Industries Limited) to protect client confidentiality while preserving industry sector context. The extraction notebook and raw data are withheld from this repository.
